```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant PR as Pull Request
  PR->>RuntimeSystem: Start Runtime Sequence
  RuntimeSystem->>DependencyManager: Analyze Changes in PR
  DependencyManager->>CorePackages: Update Dependencies and Lockfile
  CorePackages->>AuthPackage: Remove fast-check dependency
  CorePackages->>PolicyPackage: Remove fast-check dependency
  Providers->>ProviderDependencies: Update dependencies for @ai-sdk/provider-utils
  Providers->>StoragePackages: Add cross-env dependency
  CorePackages->>AllPackages: Refactor package structure and move packages (e.g., core to agents)
  DependencyManager->>Lockfile: Generate updated bun.lock reflecting new dependencies and versions
  RuntimeSystem->>PR: Finalize Runtime Configuration

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant PR as Pull Request
  PR->>CoreRuntimePackage: Initiate code review and analysis
  CoreRuntimePackage->>ProvidersPackage: Identify dead code and dependencies
  ProvidersPackage->>TestFiles: Remove deleted test files (e.g., estimateRemoteTokens.test.ts)
  ProvidersPackage->>UtilsPackage: Remove dead utility files (e.g., userMemory.ts, chronologyProviderIsolation.test.ts)
  ProvidersPackage->>ToolsPackage: Remove dead tool definitions (e.g., formatters/index.ts, stubs.ts)
  ProjectPlansPackage->>Analysis: Update provider move map documentation
  CoreRuntimePackage-->>PR: Completion of code cleanup and dependency removal
